panels.title: Front panel
panels.description: Live port state. Fill = negotiated link speed; yellow border = port is supplying PoE.

targets.expr: (ifSpeed{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"} / 1e6) * on(instance, ifIndex) (ifOperStatus{job="snmp-avaya"} == bool 1) - on(instance, ifIndex) (ifAdminStatus{job="snmp-avaya"} == bool 2)
pethPsePortDetectionStatus{job="snmp-avaya"}
count(ifOperStatus{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"} == 1)

panels.title: Ports below 1 Gb/s

targets.expr: count((ifSpeed{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"} < 1e9) and on(instance, ifIndex) (ifOperStatus{job="snmp-avaya"} == 1)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Linked ports that negotiated below gigabit: usually a bad cable pair or a 100M-only device.

targets.expr: count(pethPsePortDetectionStatus{job="snmp-avaya"} == 3) or vector(0)
count(pethPsePortDetectionStatus{job="snmp-avaya"} == 4) or vector(0)
sum(pethMainPseConsumptionPower{job="snmp-avaya"}) / sum(pethMainPsePower{job="snmp-avaya"}) * 100

panels.title: Devices (port: $port)
panels.description: MACs the switch has learned per port, with any IP from its ARP cache (only VLANs it routes). Click a port on the front panel to filter.

targets.expr: label_join(max by (port, ifAlias, dot1qFdbId, dot1qTpFdbAddress) (count_values by (dot1qTpFdbAddress, dot1qFdbId) ("port", dot1qTpFdbPort{job="snmp-avaya"} > 0) * on(port) group_left(ifAlias) label_replace(ifAlias{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"}, "port", "$1", "ifIndex", "(.*)") and on(port) label_replace(ifOperStatus{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"$port"}, "port", "$1", "ifIndex", "(.*)")), "key", "/", "dot1qTpFdbAddress", "dot1qFdbId")

max by (key, ipNetToMediaNetAddress) (label_join(label_replace(label_replace(ipNetToMediaPhysAddress{job="snmp-avaya",ipNetToMediaPhysAddress!="FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF"}, "net", "$1", "ipNetToMediaNetAddress", "(.*)\\.[0-9]+") * on(net) group_left(dot1qFdbId) max by (net, dot1qFdbId) (label_replace(count_values by (net) ("vlanif", label_replace(ipAdEntIfIndex{job="snmp-avaya"}, "net", "$1", "ipAdEntAddr", "(.*)\\.[0-9]+")), "dot1qFdbId", "$1", "vlanif", "10*([1-9][0-9]*)")), "dot1qTpFdbAddress", "$1", "ipNetToMediaPhysAddress", "(.*)"), "key", "/", "dot1qTpFdbAddress", "dot1qFdbId") and on(key) label_join(max by (port, ifAlias, dot1qFdbId, dot1qTpFdbAddress) (count_values by (dot1qTpFdbAddress, dot1qFdbId) ("port", dot1qTpFdbPort{job="snmp-avaya"} > 0) * on(port) group_left(ifAlias) label_replace(ifAlias{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"}, "port", "$1", "ifIndex", "(.*)") and on(port) label_replace(ifOperStatus{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"$port"}, "port", "$1", "ifIndex", "(.*)")), "key", "/", "dot1qTpFdbAddress", "dot1qFdbId"))

max by (ifIndex) (ifSpeed{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"} * on(instance, ifIndex) (ifOperStatus{job="snmp-avaya"} == bool 1)) and on(ifIndex) (((ifOperStatus{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"} == 1)) or on(ifIndex) (label_replace(pethPsePortDetectionStatus{job="snmp-avaya"}, "ifIndex", "$1", "pethPsePortIndex", "(.*)") == 3))

max by (ifIndex) (label_replace(pethPsePortDetectionStatus{job="snmp-avaya"}, "ifIndex", "$1", "pethPsePortIndex", "(.*)")) and on(ifIndex) (((ifOperStatus{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"} == 1)) or on(ifIndex) (label_replace(pethPsePortDetectionStatus{job="snmp-avaya"}, "ifIndex", "$1", "pethPsePortIndex", "(.*)") == 3))

max by (ifIndex) (rate(ifHCInOctets{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8) and on(ifIndex) (((ifOperStatus{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"} == 1)) or on(ifIndex) (label_replace(pethPsePortDetectionStatus{job="snmp-avaya"}, "ifIndex", "$1", "pethPsePortIndex", "(.*)") == 3))

max by (ifIndex) (rate(ifHCOutOctets{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8) and on(ifIndex) (((ifOperStatus{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"} == 1)) or on(ifIndex) (label_replace(pethPsePortDetectionStatus{job="snmp-avaya"}, "ifIndex", "$1", "pethPsePortIndex", "(.*)") == 3))

max by (ifIndex) (increase(ifInErrors{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"}[1h])) and on(ifIndex) (((ifOperStatus{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"} == 1)) or on(ifIndex) (label_replace(pethPsePortDetectionStatus{job="snmp-avaya"}, "ifIndex", "$1", "pethPsePortIndex", "(.*)") == 3))

max by (ifIndex) (increase(ifOutDiscards{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"}[1h])) and on(ifIndex) (((ifOperStatus{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"} == 1)) or on(ifIndex) (label_replace(pethPsePortDetectionStatus{job="snmp-avaya"}, "ifIndex", "$1", "pethPsePortIndex", "(.*)") == 3))

count_values("ifIndex", dot1qTpFdbPort{job="snmp-avaya"} > 0) and on(ifIndex) (((ifOperStatus{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"} == 1)) or on(ifIndex) (label_replace(pethPsePortDetectionStatus{job="snmp-avaya"}, "ifIndex", "$1", "pethPsePortIndex", "(.*)") == 3))

max by (ifIndex, lldpRemSysName, lldpRemSysDesc) (label_replace(label_replace(lldpRemSysName{job="snmp-avaya"} * on(lldpRemTimeMark, lldpRemLocalPortNum, lldpRemIndex) group_left(lldpRemSysDesc) lldpRemSysDesc{job="snmp-avaya"}, "ifIndex", "$1", "lldpRemLocalPortNum", "(.*)"), "lldpRemSysName", "(no LLDP name)", "lldpRemSysName", ""))

max by (ifIndex, ifAlias) (ifAlias{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"}) and on(ifIndex) (((ifOperStatus{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"} == 1)) or on(ifIndex) (label_replace(pethPsePortDetectionStatus{job="snmp-avaya"}, "ifIndex", "$1", "pethPsePortIndex", "(.*)") == 3))

label_replace(label_replace((rate(ifHCInOctets{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"}[$__rate_interval]) + on(instance, ifIndex) rate(ifHCOutOctets{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"}[$__rate_interval])) * 8 > 0, "port", "$1", "ifIndex", "(.*)"), "port", "0$1", "ifIndex", "(\\d)")

panels.title: Link history
panels.description: Per-port negotiated speed over the range; only ports that had a link at some point.

targets.expr: max by (port) (label_replace(label_replace(((ifSpeed{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"} / 1e6) * on(instance, ifIndex) (ifOperStatus{job="snmp-avaya"} == bool 1) - on(instance, ifIndex) (ifAdminStatus{job="snmp-avaya"} == bool 2)) and on(ifIndex) (max_over_time(ifOperStatus{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"}[$__range]) == 1), "port", "$1", "ifIndex", "(.*)"), "port", "0$1", "ifIndex", "(\\d)"))
label_replace(label_replace(rate(ifInErrors{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0, "port", "$1", "ifIndex", "(.*)"), "port", "0$1", "ifIndex", "(\\d)")
label_replace(label_replace(rate(ifOutDiscards{job="snmp-avaya",ifIndex=~"[1-9]|[1-3][0-9]|4[0-8]"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0, "port", "$1", "ifIndex", "(.*)"), "port", "0$1", "ifIndex", "(\\d)")
